paragraphs.source_en: Hardly had Nekhludoff stepped into the room next the drawing-room than she called him back.

units.source_en: Hardly had Nekhludoff stepped into the room next the drawing-room than she called him back.

paragraphs.source_en: “I shall leave a blank for what you want to say about the short-haired one, and she will give her husband his orders, and he’ll do it. Do not think me wicked; they are all so disgusting, your prologues, but *je ne leur veux pas de mal*, bother them. Well, go, but be sure to stay at home this evening to hear Kiesewetter, and we shall have some prayers. And if only you do not resist *cela vous fera beaucoup de bien*. I know your poor mother and all of you were always very backward in these things.”
